landing.testimonial.r1: A beautiful template and amazing, fast support team to go with it!
landing.testimonial.r2: A really nice to have theme, It checks all the boxes of the perfect react theme built on top of material UI
landing.testimonial.r3: Excellent theme guys. Loving simplicity and code structure so far. Keep it up.
landing.testimonial.r4: Excellent work. Project and code are clean. I bought Standard Plus to get figma file. However, the design system like list of basic components like button, input, colors, text not present so it difficult to create another design.
landing.testimonial.r5: I am very grateful for this template both code and design as well as customer service. It has really helped de-mystify and accelerate the process immensely. Thank you!
landing.testimonial.r6: I have been using the mantis for almost 2 years now and I have to say the support has been excellent. whenever i’ve had questions or ran into issues, the developer has always responded with the right resolution. It's rare to find such reliable and ongoing support over time - really appreciate it.
landing.testimonial.r7: I strongly recommend mantis react theme, that is very usefully, can help more and more productivity for our internal project, BTW my license have expired, my computer break, i lost my mantis code, i contact the mantis team, it send my a new download link, Thank you very much to them for their professional service
landing.testimonial.r8: Mantis dashboard template is the best! Its clean design shortened the app development time. It provides various components so I could easily implement the UI I wanted, and the community is active so I could solve problems quickly. I highly recommend it!!
landing.testimonial.r9: Very satisfied so far! Great team work
